notes: SR4 states only that the VARYING phrase is available in an SD as far as the Sequential I-O level allows; the compiler implements level 2 Sequential I-O and admits RECORD IS VARYING ... DEPENDING ON in an SD at 85 (V1LG and V1SH compile and sort). The refuter's finding, that a RELEASE whose DEPENDING ON value lies outside FROM/TO is still released, is real and reproduced here, but it is the obligation of §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10's last paragraph (Amendment 2), reached through §1985:XI.3.2.4 GR2, not of this availability rule; it is recorded as sibling_defect against 1985-GR-VII.3.8.4-10.

next.reason: 1985: "The availability of the VARYING phrase in the RECORD clause is dependent on the level of Sequential I-O module supported"; 2023: "SD file-name-1 [ record-clause ] . where record-clause is described in 13.18.43 (no module or level dependency)". 2023 has no modules or levels. The SD format allows the full RECORD clause without condition, so the 1985 rule tying VARYING to the Sequential I-O level is gone.
